result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection that lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. The wide, unmarked roadway and discontinuous sidewalk network create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the intersection, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning, increasing risk during crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks across all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The image shows a wide residential street with multi-family housing and a sidewalk on at least one side. The roadway features a wide painted hatched median but lacks marked crosswalks, physical pedestrian refuges, or traffic calming measures, which may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Wide roadway
hazards.description: The excessive width of the asphalt without physical narrowing or traffic calming likely encourages higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
